expected.report:
SPECIMEN:
(A) Colon polyp

MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
(A)  Sections show a polypoid fragment of large intestinal mucosa with tubulovillous architecture and high grade dysplasia, showing cribriform and back-to-back glands, loss of polarity with full-thickness nuclear stratification and markedly enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

DIAGNOSIS:
(A) COLON, Colon polyp, polypectomy - TUBULOVILLOUS ADENOMA with HIGH GRADE DYSPLASIA.
